comment: Data provenance should cover the full biospecimen lifecycle, not only the origin of clinical data. This supports participant protection, scientific validity and ISO 20387-aligned quality management.

anchor.note: p.157 l.119–121 read as the printed page

public.text: Data provenance should cover the full biospecimen lifecycle, not only the origin of clinical data. This supports participant protection, scientific validity and ISO 20387-aligned quality management.
public.suggestedRevision: Add biospecimen provenance requirements for collection, receipt, processing, parent–child and aliquot relationships, storage location, temperature excursions, quality assessment, retrieval, transfer, use, return and disposal; including actor, system, date/time and location.
